scripts.typecheck: bun check && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --bin interfere --tests -- -D warnings
scripts.typegen: fern generate --local --force && yq -i '.package.version = strenv(npm_package_version)' Cargo.toml && yq -i '.package.version = strenv(npm_package_version)' generated/Cargo.toml && yq -i '.lib.path = (.lib.path // "src/lib.rs") | ... comments = ""' generated/Cargo.toml && yq -i '.lib.path = (.lib.path // "src/lib.rs") | ... comments = ""' generated/interfere-sdk/Cargo.toml && yq -i '.lib.path = (.lib.path // "src/lib.rs") | ... comments = ""' generated/interfere-types/Cargo.toml && oxfmt generated/Cargo.toml generated/interfere-sdk/Cargo.toml generated/interfere-types/Cargo.toml && cargo update --workspace && cargo update --manifest-path generated/Cargo.toml --workspace && grep -rlF '<CLI>' generated/src | xargs -r perl -pi -e 's/<CLI>/interfere/g'

name: @interfere/cli
description: Command-line access to the Interfere API for developers and coding agents.
